Where Marketing & reviews goes wrong for Remodelers & carpenters

Project galleries sell remodelling work better than any advert, especially with room-by-room photos. Reviews describing how the job was managed matter more than price.

What Remodelers & carpenters jobs really involve

Remodelling jobs run for weeks, involve change orders and tie up cash in materials before the customer pays. Job costing and progress billing are the difference between a profitable project and one that quietly loses money.

Frequently asked questions

Which marketing & reviews tools work best for remodelers & carpenters?

The three that fit best here are Structurely (Contractors with long sales cycles who lose leads to slow follow-up), Canva Magic Studio (Trades producing their own flyers, social posts and quotes without a designer), Jasper (Businesses publishing regular content and ad copy). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does marketing & reviews software cost for remodelers & carpenters?

Across the 5 tools on this page, 3 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does marketing & reviews cause problems for remodelers & carpenters specifically?

Project galleries sell remodelling work better than any advert, especially with room-by-room photos. Reviews describing how the job was managed matter more than price.

How do I stop change orders eating the margin?

Price every change as a separate written order with its own cost and time impact before the work proceeds. Verbal changes agreed on site are where remodelling profit disappears.
